name: StepByStep
description: Animated ordered lesson/checklist scene with a title and stacked numbered steps.

title.description: Scene heading displayed above the step list.

steps.description: Native ordered step list. Compiler serializes to stepsHtml when stepsHtml is absent.

stepsHtml.description: Pre-rendered step HTML. Use .sbs-step and .sbs-num classes if hand-authoring animation targets.

qualityNotes: Use 3 to 5 steps for narrated lessons; too many rows become unreadable.
Each step should be an action, not a paragraph.
This is a teaching component, not a generic bullet slide.
